note: Webster County Conservation, in the southwest corner of the 400-acre park 5 mi N of Fort Dodge, beside 53-acre Badger Lake and the municipal golf course. Large shaded sites. The electric-only loop nearest the lake (30-41) stands in tall trees. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 75 sites, full hookups, season, $25/$30; added 50A, reservation window, 2/3-night weekend minimums, max 14, some_sites FCFS. Corrected note: lake is Badger Lake not Brushy Creek; 29 full/49 electric was wrong (25 full, 34 electric). Not waterfront holds.
flags: NOTE CORRECTION: the stored 'Brushy Creek lake' is wrong; county says 53-acre Badger Lake. Stored '29 full-hookup, 49 electric, 25 pull-throughs' disagrees with the county map's legend (25 full hookup, 34 electric-only, 8 primitive, 7 seasonal, 1 host); only the 10 reservable sites are documented as drive-through.

Base rate gap: only full-hookup $25/$30 is posted. Electric-only and primitive rates appear nowhere, so nightly_low 25 may not be the cheapest site that fits. $4 reservation fee left as stored; today's pages I read don't state it.

Not waterfront holds. Lakeward loop sites (33-37) are the closest, about 50-70 m from Badger Lake through full forest on imagery; no open apron and no county photo showing a view. Pin 42.58318,-94.19026 is at the southeast spur, about 150 m from the campground's centre: within tolerance.

7 of 75 sites are seasonal (application on the park page); the county also says 'to the full-time camper'. Not long-stay in character; 14-of-21-day limit applies to the rest in summer. mycountyparks' Camping activity says 'over 80 sites' vs the county's 75; map adds up to 75.
